newsitem.title: UK: Granada takes 53 percent of Yorkshire-Tyne.
newsitem.headline: Granada takes 53 percent of Yorkshire-Tyne.

text.p: Britain's Granada Group Plc said on Thursday it had effective ownership of 29.5 million shares in Yorkshire-Tyne Tees Television Holdings Plc, giving it 53 percent of Yorkshire's share capital.

Granada said it had received valid acceptances for 14.6 million Yorkshire shares, representing around 26.4 percent of Yorkshire's issued share capital. Granada already held some 14.8 Yorkshire shares, equivalent to 26.8 percent of the company's share capital.
Media to leisure group Granada announced a 711 million pound ($1.2 billion) bid for Yorkshire on June 25.
